root_cause: equality_key retains NaN identity in memory, but codec bytes used as entry authority collapse distinct native NaN objects. Fresh probes falsely match persisted rows; two native keys emit duplicate backing authority.
acceptance_requirements: Distinct direct and recursively nested NaN keys remain distinct.
Held native keys remain usable after save and clean cache eviction.
Map order, set equality, numeric bool/int/float representatives and Ref/tuple/frozenset keys remain native.
Integrate with the existing catalog, registry, allocator and publisher; no shadow live-object registry.
Account for non-weak-referenceable floats and externally held immutable key components; no archive-sized clean strong retention.
Validate explicit source copy, portable detach, closed schema, faults and H scaling before ordinary format activation.
